'''Star maps''', '''star charts''' or '''star-charts''' were cartographic representations of the positions of [[Star/Legends|stars]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were essential to [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]].

The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] maintained many star-charts which showed the location of legendary [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Vergence/Legends|vergences]], though by the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], many of the known vergence star-charts were clever fakes. Authentic star-charts that were recovered during the era were thousands of years old, rendering them nearly impossible to interpret.<ref name="NoP" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Empire programmed [[Bledsoe's disease]] to carry among symptoms a "window-effect" in the afflicted's eyes (resembling stars in people's eyes), with an ocular scan to retrieve the window-effect's star charts. This was to act as a subtle means of supplying intel on [[Rebel base]]s to various Imperials so they could locate and take them out.<ref name="Tatooine Sojourn">"[[Tatooine Sojourn]]"</ref>

[[Hugo Bartyn]] managed to delete the coordinates of the [[Lamaro system]] from most star-charts.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>
